description: This file defines the 'Reviewer' entity class in a Human Resource Management system, representing a reviewer with properties such as status, completed date, comment, and relationships to ratings, groups, reviews, and employees. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: Reviewer
classes.description: The 'Reviewer' class models a reviewer entity in the performance review module, with fields for status, completion date, comments, and relationships to ratings, groups, reviews, and employees. It utilizes Doctrine ORM for persistence and includes getter and setter methods for each property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the reviewer, e.g., activated, in progress, or completed.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the reviewer.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Gets the comment or note associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment or note for this reviewer.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer group associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Assigns a reviewer group to this reviewer.

methods.name: getReview
methods.description: Returns the performance review linked to this reviewer.

methods.name: setReview
methods.description: Links a performance review to this reviewer.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Gets the employee associated with this reviewer.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this reviewer.
